name: KompassFrei
about:
Essays and notes on value, money, human time, efficiency and freedom.

Author of The Measure of Value.

Kompass Frei — Securing value. Expanding horizons.

releases.title: Chapter 4: Money as a Social Technology
releases.summary:
The medium of exchange: a quiet reminder of how we think and feel... 

Excerpt from Chapter 4:
"In a fiat system –by virtue of its intrinsic characteristics and what it stands for– suspicion can but arise. Thereafter, an ever-continuing sequence of seemingly random events can but serve to condone the philosophical-political principle according to which “the end justifies the means”, rendering the prevailing monetary system utterly consistent. With sound money also, incentives can change, yet the interaction itself remains unaffected, because the medium of exchange has become neutral again. A change from fiat to sound money, then, reflects a dawning sense of value—or one that is already present."
As Bitcoiners, we cannot afford to carry fiat habits into a sound money paradigm, lest we taint even our noblest efforts with compromised means. Treat every transaction as a deliberate choice to uphold neutrality, vigilance, and what is truly at stake.

releases.title: Chapter 3: Human Time. The Only Scarce Resource
releases.summary: The mechanism that pulls the individual's effort away from creating value and toward propping up the fiat system itself is actively reinforced, no matter how slightly, every time we use the currency that sustains it. Even if we later swap our fiat income for another asset, once we internalize its denomination—or measure Bitcoin's value in fiat terms—that monetary system is upheld through our every mental disposition.

releases.title: Chapter 2: The Nature of Yield
releases.summary:
It is not merely holding Bitcoin, but what we make out of it that establishes its role as a benchmark for sound exchange. 
On our choice depends far more than we may realize...

releases.title: Chapter 1: The Lens Through Which We See Yield
releases.summary: Bitcoin: an invariable monetary benchmark for a sounder perception of value.
